name: min_cost_flow
qualification: not_qualified: bounded native composition and independent integral-flow oracle, not live throughput, camera transport or INT-FNX-001 qualification
tieBreak: maximum total delivery then minimum total cost; existing canonical residual and heap order over typed stable endpoint identities
complexityWitness: input bytes, preparation steps, both certified solver operation totals and final certificate checks
outputSizeWitness: all camera/link/recorder rows, failed identities, typed cut/partition and both complete certified flow outputs
objective: maximize aggregate delivered camera rate, then minimize total declared nonnegative link cost; every original demand remains present under failures
reduction: type-distinct source/node/link/camera/recorder/sink vertices; named links are split through private vertices to preserve parallel physical links in simple solver projections; failed components retain declarations with zero effective capacity
numericPolicy: explicit common integer rate unit and separate cost per rate unit; positive capacities/demands, nonnegative costs; checked u64 totals and checked signed i128 cost arithmetic; no wrap, saturation or approximation
constraints: all endpoints and failures name known declarations
each camera sensor has exactly one demand; failed attachments retain that demand
aggregate integral flow may split across routes
maximum-flow and min-cost-flow owners share the composition operation and output allowance
final cost-optimal flow satisfies conservation, every demand/recorder/link limit and the same minimum cut
complete rows include unused and failed components; both full certified solver runs are bound
cancellation and exhaustion return no answer or witness
counterVariables: n and m are the typed reduced graph node/arc counts; D is the total requested rate; S=n+m+1

dominantCounterBounds.max_flow_operations: sum of unchanged flow::bound(n,m) operation rows
dominantCounterBounds.min_cost_flow_operations: sum of unchanged min_cost_flow::bound(n,m,D) operation rows

compatibility: additive ALG-MCF-001 mode; uncancelled successful legacy solver identities, counters, outputs and witness bytes are unchanged; cancellation has an explicit refusal identity
noClaims: fairness or priority of partial camera allocations
spare capacity beyond the declared demand
routing changes, stream activation or effect authority
